integrity: Claims rely on explicit finite Bellman boundary-value solutions and standard stopping-time asymptotics; the included checker provides reproducible finite corroboration rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected paths, uniform independent neighbour offers with replacement, unit edge time. Gaussian statement requires fixed offer count at least two, arbitrary starting fractions, and applies to the stated optimal policy. Historical priority and independent scientific validation are not established.
title: Optimal path coverage with offered neighbours: exact cost and Gaussian fluctuations
